sections.heading: Best-Value Activities
sections.body:
Rotorua has a wide range of activities to suit all ages and budgets. Some of the best-value activities include Te Puia, which offers a geothermal park and Maori arts experience, and Wai-O-Tapu Thermal Wonderland, which features stunning geothermal landscapes.

The Agrodome Farm Show and OGO Rotorua (zorbing) are also popular activities that are sure to thrill both kids and adults. Skyline Rotorua Gondola & Luge offers panoramic views of the city and a fun luge ride.

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Families
sections.body: To make the most of your family holiday in Rotorua, consider the following money-saving tips:
list: Book activities and accommodation in advance to secure the best prices
Look for package deals that include multiple activities and services
Consider visiting during the off-season (April-May or September-November) for lower prices
Pack a picnic lunch instead of eating out for every meal
Take advantage of free activities, such as the Government Gardens and Lake Rotorua foreshore walk
Use public transport or walk/bike whenever possible to reduce transportation costs

sections.heading: When to Book for Best Prices
sections.body:
It's best to book your Rotorua family holiday during the off-season (April-May or September-November) for the lowest prices. However, if you're looking for a specific activity or accommodation, it's a good idea to book in advance to secure the best prices.

Bookme.co.nz often has last-minute deals and discounts, so it's worth checking their website regularly for promotions.
